entries.label: Regular mannequin
entries.prompt: Replace the clothes with a plain opaque cyan #5a9a9a fitted work suit, matching gloves and fitted foot coverings. Preserve every alternating support-leg pose, bent knee, raised foot, planted sole, arm and head from the revised-walk reference. Erase obsolete clothing protrusions, retain tiny neutral face features and painterly shading; preserve the exact grid and transparent background.

review.notes: Reviewed all 36 revised walking poses in two skin tints, and composited the legacy revised trousers to confirm removal of doubled legs. No skin threshold or pose limit was relaxed.

entries.label: Soft cap
entries.prompt: Add one simple soft round cap on each scalp, primary muted violet #7a5a9a with a narrow secondary muted green #5a9a6a band. Fit it tightly on the bald head and cover the crown without covering the eyes. Keep the same cap design through all four facings and all walking poses. Change only the cap; all mannequin pixels outside it stay unchanged.

review.notes: Re-registered complete candidate frames and reviewed cap/scalp fit, full hair hiding, and skirt/jacket overlap on the revised walk.

entries.label: Waves
entries.prompt: Add soft shoulder-length wavy hair in muted violet #7a5a9a. Keep the forehead and face visible in the down-facing row; paint the back of the hairstyle in the up-facing row. Follow every existing head position. Preserve the mannequin, face and all poses exactly. Natural-colour detail is limited to seams immediately bordering the hair.
entries.sourceNotes: Legacy candidate re-lock and targeted repair both failed connected-region validation. Candidate 3 was generated directly on the corrected mannequin, using the legacy candidate as a hairstyle reference. Raw attempts and exact repair prompts are retained.

review.notes: Reviewed all re-registered waves poses on the revised mannequin and legacy outfit, plus cap hide interaction. No new hair generation or per-limb adjustment.

entries.label: Knee-length skirt
entries.prompt: Add a simple knee-length A-line skirt in muted violet #7a5a9a from the waist to the knees, with painterly folds following the exact walking pose. Paint exposed lower legs and feet in cyan #5a9a9a, aligned exactly with the mannequin. No trousers or boots. Preserve torso, arms, hands and head. Keep a consistent hem length and skirt design in every frame.

review.notes: Regenerated on the revised walk, preserving raised soles and support-leg alternation. Skin region begins at 30% of waist-to-ground to include the raised legs immediately beneath the hem. All 36 frames remain connected; reviewed with cap and jacket in two palettes.

entries.label: Collared shirt
entries.prompt: Add a simple fitted collared button-front shirt with long sleeves rolled neatly to mid-forearm, in muted violet #7a5a9a, with tiny neutral buttons. Keep a tidy waist-length hem, painterly fabric folds, cyan #5a9a9a exposed forearms and hands, and exactly preserve all 36 poses.
entries.sourceNotes: Generated on the revised-walk mannequin with the existing outfit as a style reference; this is a new component painting, not a lossless re-lock of the legacy sheets.

review.notes: Reviewed all 36 frames in two tint palettes and the default-colour foundation preview. Checked shirt/jacket layering, leg alternation, raised boot soles, cuffs and skirt/boot overlap. White input matte is excluded; enclosed neutral buttons are retained. Documented region allowances preserve mannequin attachment.

entries.label: Straight trousers

Preserve every alternating support-leg pose, raised knee, raised foot and planted sole of the revised walk.

validation.regionReason: A hand occludes a small hip patch in left idle; the crossing foreground foot occludes part of the rear cuff in right walking pose 7. Both visible garment regions touch the mannequin.

entries.label: Travel jacket
entries.prompt: Add the existing short open travel jacket with notched lapels, fitted waist, small hip-length tails and rolled mid-forearm cuffs. Primary cloth is muted violet #7a5a9a; collar, lapels and cuff facings are muted green #5a9a6a. Leave the open center cyan; do not paint an undershirt. Preserve all poses.

validation.regionReason: In profile, the torso and foreground arm separate the open jacket into a main panel, far lapel, far hem and a small visible tail. Each region remains attached to the mannequin.

entries.label: Default face
entries.prompt: Paint subtle neutral default facial features only: dark brown eyes and eyebrows, a small nose accent and closed relaxed mouth. Keep the exact head outline and position, cyan skin, bald scalp and every walking pose. Profiles show only the visible eye. Back-facing heads must have no facial features. No cosmetics, facial hair, jewellery or skin-colour patches.

validation.regionReason: Eyes, brows, nose and mouth are separate facial marks; every mark must remain attached to the head.
validation.visibilityReason: Facial features are invisible on the back of the head; all nine rear-facing frames must contain no feature paint.

review.notes: Reviewed bare mannequin and full generic outfit in both skin/tint palettes across all 36 frames. Candidate 3 adds neutral visible features; the rear row is intentionally empty. Base-alpha clipping excludes flattened silhouette fringe without deleting or moving facial marks.

review.notes: Reviewed all 36 cells on bare mannequin and full outfit in two skin/tint palettes, including enlarged head crops. Candidate 1 passes unchanged face validation.

entries.label: Freckles
entries.prompt: Paint six small warm brown freckles, three on each cheek, grouped below the eye level and beside the nose. In each side profile show only three freckles on the visible cheek. Keep the sparse pattern stable across all nine poses. No other facial marks. Preserve the cyan mannequin skin, head outline and all existing cyan facial shading. Never add eyes, brows, nose lines, a mouth, hair or accessories.

validation.regionReason: Freckles are separate small spots; every spot must lie on the head.
validation.visibilityReason: Cheek markings are visible on the front and both profiles, never on the back of the head.

entries.label: Blush
entries.prompt: Paint two small softly shaded warm dusty-rose cheek patches below the eyes, one per cheek. In profiles show only the visible cheek patch. Keep the patches restrained and away from the eyes, nose and mouth; no foundation, lip colour or other facial marks. Preserve the cyan mannequin skin, head outline and all existing cyan facial shading. Never add eyes, brows, nose lines, a mouth, hair or accessories.

validation.regionReason: The two cheek patches are separate regions, each attached to the head.
validation.visibilityReason: Cheek markings are visible on the front and both profiles, never on the back of the head.

entries.label: Beauty mark
entries.prompt: Paint one small warm dark-brown beauty mark on the character's LEFT cheek, beside and slightly above the mouth corner. This is the viewer's RIGHT cheek in the front row. Show it also on the visible cheek in the RIGHT-facing second row. Do not paint any mark in the rear third row or LEFT-facing fourth row, where this cheek is hidden. A single compact softly edged spot, about three source pixels across, consistent in every visible pose; no other marks. Preserve the cyan mannequin skin, head outline and all existing cyan facial shading. Never add eyes, brows, nose lines, a mouth, hair or accessories.

validation.regionReason: A single beauty mark lies on the left cheek.
validation.visibilityReason: The left cheek is visible only from the front and right-facing view; the rear and opposite profile must contain no mark.
